▸ Validated CCAR regression, error correction, and time series models covering sensitivity analysis, stress

▸ Performed independent validations of loss forecasting models for CCAR/Stress Testing including conceptual soundness, model performance, scenario analysis, and implementation verification.

▸ Implemented IFRS9 & CECL models using PySpark on client Workbench and Zeppelin to compare model

▸ Documented findings on conceptual soundness, implementation testing, sensitivity analysis, and

▸ Created closure memos for Issues Requiring Attention (IRAs) and raised JIRA tickets for full audit trail

coverage.

▸ Performed troubleshooting of LSMR, MCE, VOMA, and Scheduler systems across all 22 telecom circles.

Oct 2015 – May 2017

▸ Independently resolved network issues for assigned zone with high reliability. ▸ Conducted LTE network testing across multiple parameters and generated Actix performance reports.

L A N G U A G E S

English • Hindi • Marathi

P R O F I L E S

Kaggle ● Tableau Public ● GitHub

Genpact | Assistant Manager – Model Validation | Feb 2022 – Present ▸ Independently validated CCAR regression and time series models — evaluated forecast accuracy, stress

scenario behaviour, and backtesting results using error metrics like MAE, MSE, and MAPE.

▸ Carried out end-to-end validation of loss forecasting models under CCAR/Stress Testing — covering

model logic review, performance benchmarking, and implementation correctness.

▸ Assessed Scorecard models for credit risk ranking — tested discriminatory power and population

stability using AUCROC, KS statistic, and PSI across multiple segments.

▸ Verified IFRS9 and CECL model implementations on PySpark — cross-checked parameter values, variable

definitions, and computation logic against expected model specifications.

▸ Built interactive dashboards using Plotly Dash to track model performance KPIs and flag anomalies for

ongoing model monitoring.

▸ Streamlined validation reporting by automating the generation of Annual Review Reports using Python,

directly embedding model outputs into structured Word documents.

▸ Utilised NumPy and Pandas to process large validation datasets — performed statistical computations,

data transformations, and pipeline automation across CCAR and IFRS9 workflows.

▸ Maintained model governance documentation — prepared IRA closure memos and logged audit trails

via JIRA for all validation findings and remediation actions.

▸ Led deep-dive independent validations of advanced ML models — XGBoost and Transformer-based —

within the MRM framework for critical underwriting and credit decisions.

▸ Assessed mathematical robustness of XGBoost classifiers — validated train-test integrity, cross-

validation design and hyperparameter sensitivity prior to production deployment.

▸ Produced MRM validation reports covering algorithmic assumptions, mathematical derivations,

implementation gaps, and model risk ratings — escalating IRAs for models not meeting production- readiness standards.

HDFC Bank | Data Operations Analyst | Jan 2021 – Feb 2022 ▸ Tested deployed credit models across retail and SME portfolios — verified score accuracy, deployment

logic, and performance definitions against development benchmarks.

▸ Reconstructed scorecard model logic from scratch — replicated variable transformations and score

calculations to independently confirm deployment correctness.

▸ Used Oracle, IBM Netezza, DB2, and Python (NumPy, Pandas) for data extraction, transformation, and

model replication tasks across multiple portfolio segments.

▸ Reviewed feature engineering pipelines and algorithmic assumptions of ML-based credit scoring models

to confirm conceptual soundness and intended-use alignment.

▸ Back-tested ML-driven underwriting models to verify PD stability and mathematical robustness across

different economic periods and borrower cohorts.

K E Y A C H I E V E M E N T S

▸ CCAR Model Validation: Collaborated with team to discontinue underperforming models through

rigorous validation. Successfully validated and implemented a predictive model that reduced forecast error by 19%.

▸ Model Accuracy Scoring: Evaluated technical accuracy of production models and proactively raised

Issues Requiring Attention (IRAs), improving overall model governance.
